record.hypothesis: Across Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics and CDs_and_Vinyl, jointly increase hidden/embedding width from 128 to 192 and reduce Adam learning rate from 1e-3 to 8e-4. Greater recurrent capacity may capture diverse interests, while smaller updates stabilize the wider model. Keep dropout 0.1 and all other settings, features, embedding normalization/tying, readout and loss unchanged. Synchronize checkpoint dimensions and predictor loading; retain one independent GRU4Rec model per category.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four datasets, increase tied embedding and GRU width to 192 while reducing Adam learning rate to 8e-4. Greater capacity may capture diverse interests, with smaller updates stabilizing optimization. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor loading propagate the new width consistently. Keep dropout and all other settings unchanged, retaining one independent GRU4Rec model per dataset.
